description: This source file contains Java unit tests for the ModifyColumnChange class within the Liquibase extension for SQL generation. It tests the generation of SQL statements and confirmation messages related to modifying columns in a database table.

classes.name: ModifyColumnChangeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the GenerateStatements and ConfirmationMessage functionalities of the ModifyColumnChange class.

methods.name: shouldGenerateStatements
methods.description: Tests the SQL statement generation for modifying columns, verifying schema name, table name, and column names.

methods.name: shouldGetConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the confirmation message generated after modifying columns, including column types and names.
